title: Planned issue batch
description: Issues drafted from the PRD. The runner creates them only after the reviewer returns the checked batch.

summary.description: One or two sentences: which milestone this batch covers and what is left.

nothing_left.description: True when the PRD has no remaining Phase 1 work that isn't already an issue.

rejected.description: Reviewer only: true to drop the whole batch (explain in summary).

key.description: Short id inside this batch, e.g. P1, P2.

milestone.description: An existing milestone title, e.g. M3.

context.description: PRD sections, decision ids and spec files this comes from.

blocked_by.description: Batch keys (P1) or existing issue numbers (#12).

key.description: Short id, e.g. Q1. Issues can list it in blocked_by.

gate_change.description: Only when accepting the recommendation means changing an owner-only gate file (.github/ including workflows and ownership.txt, scripts/ci/, .claude/, CONSTITUTION.md, any CLAUDE.md, docs/): the file(s) and the exact change, e.g. 'In .github/workflows/ci.yml, server job: add a postgres:16 service and set LUSH_TEST_DATABASE_URL for the test step.' The watcher drafts this as a PR for the owner. Leave empty otherwise.
